column1: # Nerd Font glyphs used by Omarchy and its plugins -> Tabler icons.
# Correspondence of the shell's 'Poste Nerd Font' font (config/.local/share/fonts/poste) and the island's Glyphs.js.
# Columns (tabs): code, tabler, filled, island, Nerd name, where.
#   tabler: name of the Tabler icon; '-' = glyph kept as is (no good equivalent).
#   filled: 1 = filled Tabler variant (media controls, filled heart…).
#   island: empty = same icon in the island; otherwise the name the island keeps (meaning specific to the island).
#   where: files that use it (menu = omarchy-menu.jsonc), for the record.
